compile_command: python3 tools/qwen_rom_exact_cuda_matvec.py compile --nvrtc <bundled libnvrtc.so.12> --arch compute_120 --output qwen_exact_matvec.ptx
fixture_comparisons: All output uint32 bits against unchanged Torch gpu_matvec and hdc_golden.matvec
future_api: ExactMatvec(ptx).install(oracle); identical gpu_matvec(wT,x,split) API, unscaled FP32 NumPy result
default_behavior: Original oracle and producer files are byte-identical; existing entrypoints do not select the leaf.
recurrence: One thread per split,row; serial increasing K, explicit RN mul followed by RN add, +0 after each; one separate adjacent-pair kernel per split-tree level.
input: Existing hdc_golden.to_bf16; borrowed wT[kc,split,row] with actual positive strides, including sliced head rows.
scratch_bytes: 4*n*(split + split/2) for split>1, otherwise 4*n; no duplicate weight cache
performance_limit: Three timing samples at 15 rows, K128, split8 only, both include BF16 round/upload/download; no whole-producer speedup measured.
